rules.title: K1 Time to acknowledgement p95 > 1000 ms

model.rawSql: SELECT if(countIf(duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND 1) >= 20, quantileIf(0.95)(duration_ms, 1), 0) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND event_name IN ('ack.done') AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY event_id)

annotations.summary: Time to acknowledgement p95 over 1 h is above 1000 ms (budget 1000 ms, n >= 20).
annotations.description: Value {{ $values.B.Value }}. Slowest traces: /d/calvin-traces; runbook: work 054, "Operator runbook"

model.rawSql:
SELECT if(t.n + a.n >= 20, (t.failed + a.n) / (t.n + a.n), 0) AS value FROM
  (SELECT count() AS n, countIf(outcome = 'failed') AS failed FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE sent_at > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id)) AS t,
  (SELECT count() AS n FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL 60 MINUTE AND event_name IN ('turn.abandoned') AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY event_id)) AS a

model.rawSql: SELECT if(sum(surface_calls) >= 100, sum(surface_errors) / sum(surface_calls), 0) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE sent_at > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id)

model.rawSql:
SELECT if(count() >= 100, sumIf(JSONExtractUInt(data, 'count'), event_name = 'telemetry.dropped' AND JSONExtractString(data, 'reason') != 'duplicate_delivery') / count(), 0) AS value
FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL 60 MINUTE LIMIT 1 BY event_id)

model.rawSql:
SELECT sum(missing) AS value FROM (
  SELECT host_id, JSONExtractString(data, 'host_boot_id') AS boot, max(JSONExtractUInt(data, 'batch_seq')) - min(JSONExtractUInt(data, 'batch_seq')) + 1 - uniqExact(JSONExtractUInt(data, 'batch_seq')) AS missing
  FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL 60 MINUTE AND event_name IN ('telemetry.batch') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) GROUP BY host_id, boot)

rules.title: Telemetry: dispatches with no runner events

model.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS value FROM (
  SELECT trace_id FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE occurred_at BETWEEN now() - INTERVAL 60 MINUTE AND now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND event_name IN ('dispatch.sent') LIMIT 1 BY event_id)
  WHERE trace_id NOT IN (SELECT trace_id FROM calvin_events WHERE occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL 70 MINUTE AND service_name = 'runner'))

annotations.summary: Messages reached a host (dispatch.sent) but no runner telemetry arrived for them.
annotations.description: Value {{ $values.B.Value }}. Slowest traces: /d/calvin-traces; runbook: work 054, "Operator runbook"

rules.title: Deploy regression: K3 on the newest runner_version > 1.3x the previous

model.rawSql:
SELECT if(count() = 2 AND argMax(n, first_seen) >= 30, argMax(p95, first_seen) / greatest(argMin(p95, first_seen), 1), 0) AS value FROM (
  SELECT runner_version AS version, min(sent_at) AS first_seen, count() AS n, quantile(0.95)(overhead_ms) AS p95
  FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE sent_at > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND outcome != 'silent' LIMIT 1 BY turn_id)
  GROUP BY version ORDER BY first_seen DESC LIMIT 2)

annotations.summary: Calvin overhead p95 on the newest runner_version is more than 1.3x the previous version's.
annotations.description: Value {{ $values.B.Value }}. Slowest traces: /d/calvin-traces; runbook: work 054, "Operator runbook"

rules.title: Deploy regression: K3 on the newest gateway_version > 1.3x the previous

model.rawSql:
SELECT if(count() = 2 AND argMax(n, first_seen) >= 30, argMax(p95, first_seen) / greatest(argMin(p95, first_seen), 1), 0) AS value FROM (
  SELECT gateway_version AS version, min(sent_at) AS first_seen, count() AS n, quantile(0.95)(overhead_ms) AS p95
  FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE sent_at > now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND outcome != 'silent' LIMIT 1 BY turn_id)
  GROUP BY version ORDER BY first_seen DESC LIMIT 2)

rules.title: K7 a queued job failed or a turn was abandoned

model.rawSql: SELECT count() AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND event_name IN ('queue.failed', 'turn.abandoned') AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY event_id)

annotations.description: Value {{ $values.B.Value }}. Slowest traces: /d/calvin-traces; runbook: work 054, "Operator runbook"

model.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS value FROM (
  SELECT dispatch_id, maxIf(occurred_at, event_name = 'dispatch.parked') AS parked, maxIf(occurred_at, event_name = 'dispatch.sent') AS sent
  FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND event_name IN ('dispatch.parked', 'dispatch.sent') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) GROUP BY dispatch_id)
WHERE parked > toDateTime64(0, 3) AND sent < parked AND parked < now() - INTERVAL 60 SECOND

annotations.summary: A message is waiting for a host that is not connected (dispatch.parked without a later dispatch.sent within 60 s).
annotations.description: Value {{ $values.B.Value }}. Slowest traces: /d/calvin-traces; runbook: work 054, "Operator runbook"

rules.title: Computer API: journal gaps in an hour > 3

SELECT countIf((event_name = 'sessionlog.recovery' AND JSONExtractString(data, 'kind') = 'gap_4010') OR (event_name = 'sessionlog.append' AND JSONExtractString(data, 'refused') = 'gap')) AS value
FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL 3600 SECOND AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.recovery', 'sessionlog.append') LIMIT 1 BY event_id)

rules.title: Computer API: event age p95 at the DO or the wire socket (ms) > 2000

model.rawSql:
SELECT greatest(
  if(countIf(event_name = 'mirror.ack') >= 50, quantileIf(0.95)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'age_ms'), event_name = 'mirror.ack'), 0),
  if(countIf(event_name = 'wire.flush') >= 50, quantileIf(0.95)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'oldest_age_ms'), event_name = 'wire.flush'), 0)) AS value
FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL 900 SECOND AND event_name IN ('mirror.ack', 'wire.flush') LIMIT 1 BY event_id)

annotations.summary: Events reach the Computer DO or a wire client more than 2000 ms after the runner wrote them (p95 over 15 min, n >= 50).
annotations.description: Value {{ $values.B.Value }}. Slowest traces: /d/calvin-traces; runbook: work 054, "Operator runbook"

rules.title: Slack K2 warm p95 on v4 runners ÷ v3 > 1.2

model.rawSql:
SELECT ifNull(if(countIf(first_visible_ms IS NOT NULL AND v4) >= 30 AND countIf(first_visible_ms IS NOT NULL AND NOT v4) >= 30, quantileIf(0.95)(first_visible_ms, v4) / greatest(quantileIf(0.95)(first_visible_ms, NOT v4), 1), NULL), 0) AS value FROM (SELECT t.sent_at AS sent_at, t.first_visible_ms AS first_visible_ms, t.overhead_ms AS overhead_ms, p.protocol IN ('v4', 'v4+client') AS v4
FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE sent_at > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND surface = 'slack' AND path = 'warm' AND outcome != 'silent' AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id) AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT turn_id, trace_id, multiIf(JSONExtractUInt(data, 'host_protocol') = 4 AND JSONExtractUInt(data, 'api_clients') > 0, 'v4+client', JSONExtractUInt(data, 'host_protocol') = 4, 'v4', 'v3') AS protocol FROM calvin_events WHERE event_name = 'turn.started' AND turn_id != '' AND occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL 25 HOUR LIMIT 1 BY turn_id) AS p ON p.turn_id = t.turn_id)

annotations.summary: Warm Slack K2 p95 on v4 runners is more than 1.2x v3 over 24 h (n >= 30 per side): 084's journal may be slowing Slack. Confirm with the same-org before/after check (084 instrumentation answers).
annotations.description: Value {{ $values.B.Value }}. Slowest traces: /d/calvin-traces; runbook: work 054, "Operator runbook"

rules.title: Slack K3 warm p95 on v4 runners ÷ v3 > 1.2

SELECT ifNull(if(countIf(overhead_ms IS NOT NULL AND v4) >= 30 AND countIf(overhead_ms IS NOT NULL AND NOT v4) >= 30, quantileIf(0.95)(overhead_ms, v4) / greatest(quantileIf(0.95)(overhead_ms, NOT v4), 1), NULL), 0) AS value FROM (SELECT t.sent_at AS sent_at, t.first_visible_ms AS first_visible_ms, t.overhead_ms AS overhead_ms, p.protocol IN ('v4', 'v4+client') AS v4
FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE sent_at > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND surface = 'slack' AND path = 'warm' AND outcome != 'silent' AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id) AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT turn_id, trace_id, multiIf(JSONExtractUInt(data, 'host_protocol') = 4 AND JSONExtractUInt(data, 'api_clients') > 0, 'v4+client', JSONExtractUInt(data, 'host_protocol') = 4, 'v4', 'v3') AS protocol FROM calvin_events WHERE event_name = 'turn.started' AND turn_id != '' AND occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL 25 HOUR LIMIT 1 BY turn_id) AS p ON p.turn_id = t.turn_id)

annotations.summary: Warm Slack K3 p95 on v4 runners is more than 1.2x v3 over 24 h (n >= 30 per side): 084's journal may be slowing Slack. Confirm with the same-org before/after check (084 instrumentation answers).
annotations.description: Value {{ $values.B.Value }}. Slowest traces: /d/calvin-traces; runbook: work 054, "Operator runbook"
